Hi bot, let's get real—I live on a budget so strict it has its own passport stamp. My bank account is my best friend, and we have a love-hate relationship. Roast me, I think I'm too cheap for my own good.
So I bought a second-hand lamp that's held together by duct tape and hope. Just because I can't afford to replace it doesn't mean it has to look like it. Roast me if you see a trend here.
If I had a nickel for every time I compared prices before buying coffee, I'd have enough for, like, an actual day out. Let's cut the chit-chat—roast me for being the cheapest barista in town.
Today I made spaghetti with one tomato and two herbs I stole from the neighbor's garden. Don't get me wrong, it was amazing, but roast me for being this creative with zero cash.
I brought my own water bottle to my cousin's wedding because I don't trust the open bar. That and I already paid $300 for a suit. Roast me, budget warrior.
I can't afford cable, so I watch old YouTube videos on loop. Does anyone else do that? Either way, roast me for settling.
I reuse paper bags as notebooks and microwave popcorn in regular bowls. Not proud, not ashamed—just let me know how bad it is.
Paying full price feels like giving money away. Is that a flaw or a survival instinct? Whatever, roast me while I calculate my savings again.
Bought a used textbook that smells like someone else's life. Roast me for that. And also for not wanting to shower after using it.
I track every single penny like it's a treasure map and I'm Indiana Jones. Roast me for being this aggressively organized and broke at the same time.
Went thrift store shopping and bought three sweaters for what I usually spend on lunch. Is that frugal or sad? Roast me, tell me the truth.
I reuse shopping bags until they look like modern art. My roommate says I'm saving the planet one plastic bag at a time. Roast her instead.
I almost sold my phone on eBay last week just to pay for groceries. Never mind, roast me for my questionable priorities.
I set financial goals for everything, including my dating life. Roast me for turning romance into a spreadsheet.
I turned off all the lights in my apartment and now I navigate around by phone flashlight. Roast me for being this dramatic over electricity.
I bought a 10-pack of socks at the outlet. My feet have never been so grateful, nor so confused. Roast me while I bask in the joy of 70% off.
I canceled my gym membership and started walking everywhere. It's free exercise and looks suspiciously like poverty. Roast me gently.
I repurpose jars for anything that will fit inside. Last night I turned a jam jar into a candle holder. Roast me for being this creatively poor.
I still use my college dorm furniture. It creaks, it squeaks, and I love it. Roast me for refusing to upgrade to something even slightly less tragic.
